name: agent-vault
description: The credential proxy's command: starts a process with an Agent Vault session so that its HTTP and HTTPS requests route through the vault's proxy, which attaches the credentials the process never sees. Use it to run a command that needs a credential the shop holds in the vault — the session-handoff process's push among them.
tool_owner: no shop named — the tool's provenance as shown whoever runs it (`agent-vault 0.32.0`, commit e01a925, and its help) names none; the lead shop holds the gap as its own until an owner is found

uses.name: run
uses.description: Starts <command> with a vault-scoped session: sets the proxy and root-CA variables on the child so its HTTP and HTTPS clients route through the vault, mints the session token from the on-disk login (or takes it from AGENT_VAULT_TOKEN, AGENT_VAULT_ADDR, and AGENT_VAULT_VAULT in agent mode), then runs the command; everything after `--` is the command. Runs nothing else; the child's exit status is the use's.

command.description: the command and its arguments to run under the session, written after `--`

vault.description: the vault the session is scoped to; omitted, the active context's vault

returns.text: two lines on standard error, `agent-vault: routing HTTP/HTTPS through MITM proxy (<host>:<port>)` and `agent-vault: agent-vault connected. Starting <command>...`, then the command's own output on its own streams; exit status the command's — 0 when the command exits 0

failures.condition: no command follows `--`: on standard error `Error: requires at least 1 arg(s), only received 0` and the usage sheet; nothing is started
failures.next: write the command after `--` and run the invocation again
